sources.notes: Person-centred review requires author-identity, named-project, lineage, limitation, evaluation, and adjacent follow-up queries beyond the static embodied-AI taxonomy.

queries.label: dynamic-author-linxi-fan
queries.why: Primary arXiv author spelling established by the author's homepage and paper records.

queries.label: dynamic-author-jim-fan
queries.query: all:"Jim Fan" AND (all:agent OR all:robot OR all:reinforcement)
queries.why: Checks the public name variant while constraining same-name noise.

queries.label: dynamic-early-scale-lineage
queries.query: all:("Deep Speech 2" OR "Ladder Network" OR "World of Bits" OR SURREAL OR SECANT)
queries.why: Covers the early sequence from large-scale learning systems to visual-agent generalization.

queries.label: dynamic-generalist-control-lineage
queries.query: all:(MetaMorph OR MineDojo OR VIMA) AND (all:agent OR all:robot OR all:control)
queries.why: Covers morphology-general control, open-ended environments, and multimodal robot prompting.

queries.label: dynamic-llm-agent-lineage
queries.query: all:(Voyager OR Eureka OR DrEureka) AND (all:agent OR all:robot OR all:reward)
queries.why: Covers LLM-written skills, curricula, rewards, and sim-to-real transfer.

queries.label: dynamic-physical-ai-lineage
queries.query: all:(GR00T OR DreamGen OR DexUMI OR HumanoidMimicGen OR "Sim-and-Real Co-Training" OR "CaP-X")
queries.why: Covers later physical-AI, humanoid, data-generation, and code-as-policy work associated with Linxi Fan.

queries.label: dynamic-open-ended-agents-mechanism
queries.query: all:"open-ended" AND all:(embodied OR agent) AND all:(knowledge OR lifelong OR curriculum)
queries.why: Captures the mechanism surface linking MineDojo and Voyager rather than only their names.

queries.label: dynamic-foundation-policy-mechanism
queries.query: all:("foundation model" OR multimodal OR language) AND all:(robot OR embodied) AND all:(policy OR action OR control)
queries.why: Captures the transition from multimodal prompting to action-producing foundation policies.

queries.label: dynamic-video-world-model-robot
queries.query: all:"video world model" AND all:(robot OR manipulation OR humanoid) AND all:(policy OR data OR control)
queries.why: Covers the later use of generative video/world models for robot data and policy learning.

queries.label: dynamic-external-minecraft-evaluation
queries.query: all:(Minecraft OR MineDojo OR Voyager) AND all:(benchmark OR evaluation OR generalization OR ablation)
queries.why: Finds independent or comparative evaluation of open-world agent claims.

queries.label: dynamic-external-robot-prompt-evaluation
queries.query: all:(VIMA OR "multimodal prompt" OR "code as policy") AND all:robot AND all:(benchmark OR evaluation OR limitation)
queries.why: Finds comparison and boundary evidence for prompted robot agents.

queries.label: dynamic-external-reward-code-limit
queries.query: all:("language model" OR LLM) AND all:(reward OR code) AND all:(robot OR embodied) AND all:(failure OR limitation OR robustness OR safety)
queries.why: Targets counter-evidence and transfer limits for LLM-generated rewards or control code.

queries.label: dynamic-humanoid-foundation-evaluation
queries.query: all:(humanoid OR "generalist robot") AND all:(foundation OR pretraining) AND all:(benchmark OR real-world OR evaluation OR generalization)
queries.why: Finds evidence needed to evaluate later physical-AI scaling claims outside project announcements.

queries.label: dynamic-physical-ai-deployment
queries.query: all:(humanoid OR "robot foundation model") AND all:(deployment OR reliability OR recovery OR latency OR safety)
queries.why: Prevents engineering demos and industrial readiness from being conflated.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-author-browser
browser_fallback_queries.why: Recover author papers if the arXiv API under-recovers.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-project-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (MineDojo OR VIMA OR Voyager OR Eureka OR DrEureka OR GR00T OR DreamGen) robot agent

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-official-identity
web_calibration_queries.query: Jim Fan official NVIDIA homepage publications
web_calibration_queries.why: Confirm identity, public name variants, and official project vocabulary.

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-current-projects
web_calibration_queries.why: Calibrate current NVIDIA project and lab vocabulary without accepting claims from snippets.
